title: crates/sieve-native: workspace skeleton and public API surface
description:
Create the crates/sieve-native crate with the same public API as usenet-ipfs-sieve so smtp can swap deps with zero call-site changes.

What: Cargo.toml (MIT), src/lib.rs with stub implementations.

Algorithm:
1. Add 'crates/sieve-native' to workspace members in root Cargo.toml.
2. crates/sieve-native/Cargo.toml: name=usenet-ipfs-sieve-native, license=MIT, no sieve-rs dep. Add: serde (optional), tracing.
3. src/lib.rs: define public surface matching existing usenet-ipfs-sieve:
   - pub struct CompiledScript(pub(crate) Vec<Statement>);  // AST placeholder
   - pub enum SieveAction { Keep, FileInto(String), Discard, Reject(String) }
   - pub fn compile(script: &[u8]) -> Result<CompiledScript, String>  // stub: Err("not implemented")
   - pub fn evaluate(script: &CompiledScript, message: &[u8], env_from: &str, env_to: &str) -> Vec<SieveAction>  // stub: vec![SieveAction::Keep]
4. cargo check -p usenet-ipfs-sieve-native passes.
5. Verify 'cargo tree -p usenet-ipfs-sieve-native | grep sieve-rs' returns empty.

Defensive rules: license field must be exactly 'MIT'; no sieve-rs dep at any level.
notes: Add fancy-regex = "0.13" to Cargo.toml deps (needed by evaluator for :regex match type).
